[RDSC.5.8.1] The `SchemaDef` atom carries the canonical protobuf
definition for a schema. The DS author does not write
protobuf; the compiler generates the .proto from the
schema's DS declaration. The .proto is the cross-boundary
shape for instances of the schema, per `[LFST.8.10]` and
`[LFST.11.9]`.
